_comment: The job registry: what each scheduled job is and how often it runs. The notifier reads cadence and purpose from here, so no sender has to restate them.

disk-check.what: Compares free space on the root volume and the backup volume against fixed bands.

nightly-backup.what: Dumps the application databases and copies them to the backup volume.

usage-check.what: Fails when any usage collector has stopped running or has run without adding rows.

token-expiry-check.what: Lists third-party integrations whose access token expires within three days.

queue-repair.what: Retries items that have been stuck in the import queue for more than a day.

daily-summary.what: One line on yesterday's job runs: how many ran, how many failed.

renewal-reminder.what: Lists subscriptions that renew in the next 14 days.

notify-digest.what: Rolls every held notification into one morning push.
